# Central Ohio Window Guide

> A homeowner resource covering smart home window automation, motorized shades, blinds, shutters, and window treatment costs in Columbus and Central Ohio. Published by Olsson Smart Shades, a local Central Ohio installer.

## Local installer
- Olsson Smart Shades (https://olssonss.com, (614) 907-0976) is the local Central Ohio installer that publishes this guide. Based at 7780 Corporate Blvd, Suite 1506, Plain City, OH 43064, serving Columbus, Dublin, Upper Arlington, Powell, Westerville, New Albany, Hilliard, Worthington, Delaware, Lancaster, and the rest of Central Ohio. Mon-Sat 9am-6pm.
- Authorized dealer for Norman (shutters, blinds, shades, Norman Smart Motorization), Draper (projection screens and exterior shading), InsolRoll (exterior solar shades), and DrapeMax (drapery).
- Services: motorized and smart shades (also called automated blinds or automated window treatments), plantation shutters, cellular and roller shades, blinds, custom drapery, exterior patio shades, Draper projection screens, and residential and commercial window film including anti-shatter security film.
- Every window is measured and every order installed by the company's own team; nothing is subcontracted. Free in-home consultations, with a written quote delivered the same day as the measure. A real person answers the phone.
- Not affiliated with Olsson Blind & Shutter, a separate company.
